name: エッジシャープネス分散解析
description: Analyzes edge sharpness variance across quadrants
algorithm: Edge Sharpness Variance — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes edge sharpness variance across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **エッジSharpness測定**: For each frame, edge sharpness is quantified at detected edges using maximum gradient magnitude, edge width (10-90% rise distance), and modulation transfer function (MTF) estimation. This characterizes the optical sharpness at each edge location.

2. **空間的SharpnessMap**: A per-frame sharpness map reveals spatial variation. Natural images show physically motivated sharpness patterns: sharp at the focal plane, decreasing with distance (depth-of-field), possibly with lens softening at corners (vignetting). AI-generated images may show unnatural sharpness distributions.

3. **顔-BackgroundSharpness比較**: Sharpness characteristics of the face and background should be consistent with the same optical system. Deepfakes may show face regions with different sharpness than the background — either sharper (high-resolution face generator on lower-resolution source video) or differently blurred (wrong focus simulation).

4. **時間的Sharpness分散分析**: Edge sharpness across frames should vary smoothly (focus changes, motion blur). The method measures frame-to-frame sharpness variance — elevated temporal variance indicates deepfake artifacts where the generator produces inconsistent sharpness rendering across frames.

5. **Sharpness異常スコアリング**: The combined analysis of spatial sharpness consistency, face-background sharpness coherence, and temporal stability produces a forensic score. High variance without physical explanation (no focus pull, no motion) indicates AI generation or manipulation.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through edge sharpness variance analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
